node.title: A pair space has a short independent polynomial normal or a generically full projection
node.statement: For W subset V x V, dim V=s, dim W=r and c=2s-r, either pi_z(a,b)=a+zb is surjective over F(z), in which case all but at most c finite gamma have pi_gamma(W)=V, or a minimum nonzero polynomial normal ell(z) exists with independent coefficients ell0..ell_d and d+2<=c. If the component-image sum is V then d>=1, so the moving-normal hypersurface degree e=d+1 lies in2..c-1. Cofactor identities prove the alternatives in every characteristic. F(z) is a formal rank test, not a challenge-field transfer. No source count or regular-branch payment is claimed.
